info.name: Temenos Transact Core Banking Accounts Payments API

items.docs: Initiate a fund transfer between accounts. Supports internal transfers, domestic payments, and cross-border transfers. Validates accounts, calculates charges and exchange rates, and processes the payment according to configured payment rules and cut-off times.

info.name: Temenos Transact Get Fund Transfer Details

params.name: transferId
params.description: Unique identifier of the fund transfer

items.docs: Retrieve the status and details of a specific fund transfer including processing status, value date, charges applied, exchange rate, and any error details.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of records to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: page_start
params.description: Page token or offset for pagination

items.docs: Retrieve a list of payment orders. Supports filtering by status, debit account, credit account, date range, and payment type. Includes pending, processed, and rejected payment orders.

Submit a new payment order for processing. Validates the payment details, calculates charges and execution times, and queues the payment for processing. Supports various payment types including SEPA, SWIFT, ACH, and domestic clearing.

info.name: Temenos Transact Get Payment Order Details

params.name: paymentOrderId
params.description: Unique identifier of the payment order

items.docs: Retrieve detailed information for a specific payment order including status, amount, charges, exchange rate, execution date, and processing details.

params.name: paymentOrderId
params.description: Unique identifier of the payment order to cancel

items.docs: Request cancellation of a pending payment order. Only payment orders in PENDING or PROCESSING status can be cancelled. Returns the updated payment order status.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Number of records to return per page (default 25, max 100)

params.name: page_start
params.description: Page token or offset for pagination

items.docs: Retrieve standing order instructions for recurring payments. Supports filtering by account, frequency, status, and next execution date.
Create a new standing order instruction for recurring payments. Defines the debit account, beneficiary, amount, frequency, start date, and optional end date.
